scripts.dev: npm run db:start && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names engine,web --prefix-colors gray,white "npm run dev:engine" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:engine: uv run --directory apps/engine uvicorn engine.main:app --reload --reload-dir src --port 8000
scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:web
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/web run lint && uv run --directory apps/engine ruff check
